categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the research, manufacture, and sale of cellulose acetate products including acetate tow, acetate flakes, and acetic anhydride. It also produces cellulose acetate filament fabrics, plastic-grade acetate flakes for various applications such as eyeglass frames and mobile phone cases, and is expanding into biodegradable textile fibers and AI-related high-end optical materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced cellulose acetate production technologies including medium temperature acetification, dissolution, filtration, spinning, crimping, drying, and packaging. It emphasizes process optimization, high automation, and proprietary R&D capabilities to produce high-quality acetate tow and filament. The company also invests in green and environmentally friendly materials development and AI optical material technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major global tobacco companies such as Philip Morris International and British American Tobacco, with products mainly used in cigarette filters. Other markets served include textile manufacturers for high-end apparel, medical and hygiene products like diapers and facial masks, and plastic product manufacturers for items such as eyeglass frames and mobile phone cases. The company targets emerging markets in Africa, Middle East, South America, and Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with manufacturing plants in Shandong Province and a representative office in Taiwan. It exports products to over 50 countries worldwide, with significant sales in Asia, Europe, America, and Africa. The company also has a holding headquarters in the Cayman Islands and plants in Hong Kong.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates vertically integrated production covering upstream raw material processing (cellulose acetate flakes), midstream manufacturing of acetate tow and filament, and downstream sales to cigarette filter manufacturers and other end users. It integrates upstream and downstream resources to optimize production efficiency and reduce costs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding production capacity for tow and filament yarn, developing special specification products to meet diverse customer needs, and investing in green, biodegradable materials. The company is also focusing on AI technology applications, particularly in high-end optical materials for smart wearable devices, and strengthening R&D collaborations with international partners.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of cellulose acetate tow, flakes, filament yarn, and related chemical products. The company also benefits from strategic alliances and exports to global tobacco manufacturers and other industrial customers. Revenue growth is driven by volume increases, product diversification, and maintaining high selling prices.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with major multinational cellulose acetate producers such as Solvay, Eastman, Celanese, and Daicel. It holds an estimated global market share of approximately 6.88% in cellulose acetate tow production. The company differentiates itself through independent technology, vertical integration, and focus on emerging markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of NT$15.7 billion, a 42.52% increase from the previous year, and net profit after tax of NT$8.39 billion, a 60.58% increase. Total assets grew by 74.84% to NT$21 billion, reflecting capacity expansion and strong operational performance. The company maintains a stable financial position with increasing retained earnings and equity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, stable cellulose acetate products with customized specifications to meet diverse customer requirements. It leverages proprietary manufacturing technology, vertical integration, and R&D capabilities to offer competitive pricing and innovative products such as biodegradable fibers and AI optical materials. Its strong customer relationships and service further enhance its market position.
